-- Reads one name confined to the directory `notes`.
-- Returns None when the file is missing, unreadable, or the name escapes `notes`.
try_read(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  ex try_read("../secret.txt") == None
  ex try_read("/etc/passwd") == None
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return None
  for part in name.split("/")
    if part == "" or part == ".."
      return None
  for part in name.split("\\")
    if part == "" or part == ".."
      return None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    return text

-- Returns the text of the first name in `names` that can be read from `notes`,
-- or "" when none can.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret.txt", "/etc/passwd"]) == ""
  for n in names
    let t = try_read(n)
    if t != None
      return t else ""
  ""
